title: Titanfall 2 x Helldiver 2 mashup
author: Kind-Past5125
selftext:
Can somebody please make a Titanfall 2 x Helldiver II mashup in melty.gg?

The game should work as following:

You are a Titanfall 2 Pilot in helldivers. Enemies need heavy penetration to attack a titan, except for the critical points, which only need light penetration. Anti titan weapons should have heavy penetrations while most assault rifles have medium penetration and light weapons such as most smg's and light pistols have light penetration.  
The ai should also add newly generated spawn points for titans, just like in Titanfall, where there are predestined Titanfall points. Explosion damage should be translated into explosion damage like the MGW and SMR. Firestars and such should burn enemies just like in Helldivers. The Pilot has about the same hp as a medium armor Helldiver. Wall running etc. should obviously also be integrated.

Please, i need this and don't have a claude pro account.
